6684c32c49ea2a054e090b8c.blurb: Club 8's latest LP is a bright and uplifting set of afropop-inspired songs. It might be the album for you if you're still looking for a way to start your summer off right. There is a lot of sameness to this thing, though.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090b95.blurb: On their debut EP, Superhumanoids crafts a definitive sound and reworks a few old demos. These six tracks should be real attention-grabbers for the krautrock crowd. The linear, minimalist approach of Superhumanoids' rock is clean, sanitary, and straightforward.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090bab.blurb: On Baths debut LP, we've got enough colorful beats to smother a chillwave producer. Dreamy synths, sharp snares, and sweet vocals make this album a pretty easygoing experience. It's undeniably instant, but there's a lot to learn from repeated listens.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090baf.blurb: On Best Coast's debut album, the project really brings what the singles promised: sunny songs for the summer heat. Lots of distorted guitars, reverb-soaked drums, and lethargic lyrics.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090bcb.blurb: On their first album in six years, Autolux enhances the experimental sounds they forged on 2004's Future Present. Tracks like Audience No. 2 bring are a real sensory overload, packing the mix with distortion and effects.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090bd2.blurb: On their fifteenth studio album, Iron Maiden has refined the progressive elements they relied on with 2006's A Matter of Life and Death. Many of the intros and instrumental passages are drawn out, but they add more to the songs than they take away.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090bd4.blurb: Teen Daze debut EP is a relaxing, beat-driven set of tracks that'll chill your bones and heat up the dancefloor. It's an easygoing release that's perfect for summer. My one and only issue with it is the sounds are really nothing to get excited about.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090be7.blurb: Mogwai's new live album is impressive. There's no other way to put it, really. Despite some minor flaws, the sound is great and the performances are on point.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090c33.blurb: Sufjan's latest LP isn't going to go down in history as one of my favorites, but it's not like it's all that bad either.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090c51.blurb: Warpaint's debut LP is an album of deeply hypnotic rock songs that slowly unfold with one phrase evolving into the next. 6684c32c49ea2a054e090c54.blurb: Diamond Rings' debut full-length is a pop album that knows its limits, but shows no signs of shame or fear. The project's founder, John O, brings passion into everything  he touches on this album.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090ca8.blurb: Röyksopp's fourth album comes quickly on the heels of their third, and serves as a stark contrast to it's predecessor.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090cc1.blurb: Big Blood's latest album isn't the most consistent, but it's sounds are still extremely haunting and odd. It's a psychedelic and experimental approach to folk music--with a hint of drone added in for good measure, of course.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090cc2.blurb: On this followup to Plastic Beach, Gorillaz bring together some pretty rough ideas and simple demos. Given, the sounds here are much better than what most people can create on a MacBook--never mind an iPad.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090cca.blurb: jj's new mixtape is harmless in theory, but don't let the soft, pink cover fool you. This thing is a relentless gauntlet of auto-tuned madness.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090cd2.blurb: On Wire's twelfth studio album, the band embraces the minimalism and simple pop hooks that make their post-Pink Flag albums so appealing.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090cea.blurb: On Fergus & Geronimo's debut LP, the Texas duo tries their hand at doo wop, powerpop, and oddball garage tunes. Shockingly, they do it all pretty well.

fav.t: WANNA KNOW WHAT I WOULD DO?

6684c32c49ea2a054e090cee.blurb: Deerhoof's 10th album is built on the same freewheeling creativity that has made their past LPs such fun listens. The album changes without warning from sound to sound and song to song, which only plays into the quirky attitude.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090cf0.blurb: Destroyer's latest album is an unexpected change of pace from Dan Bejar and the gang. Rather than continuing to embrace the folk, glam, baroque pop aesthetics that brought the band this far, Kaputt emulates the sounds of disco, new wave, and smooth jazz.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d05.blurb: On John Vanderslices' latest album, the singer-songwriter works with California's Magik*Magik Orchestra to bring a new level of intricacy to his music.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d07.blurb: Dumbo Gets Mad's debut album is a pretty hefty piece of psychedelic rock and pop. Rarely does anything about this LP come off as "normal." We're basically talking about an album full of odd synths, chipmunked vocals, bubble samples, and lyrics about prawns.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d20.blurb: When it comes to black metal, Vreid's V is as melodic and thrashy as they come. It's actually difficult to simply call it a black metal album.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d21.blurb: Nicolas Jaar's debut LP is a dark exercise in bleak dance beats, sound collages, and ambient interludes. Though the album doesn't come off with a clear intent, Space Is Only Noise makes for a really heady and beautiful listen.

fav.t: SPACE IS ONLY NOISE IF YOU CAN SEE

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d22.blurb: Radiohead's latest LP is a fan-pleasing piece of work. It's loaded with beautiful and well-recorded sounds, and even Thom Yorke's songwriting shows some muscle with moments like "Lotus Flower" and "Separator."

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d24.blurb: Colin Stetson's latest album redefines the saxophone in an avant-garde context. His drones, motifs, and highly technical sax runs are undeniably gripping and beautiful.

fav.t: STARS IN HIS HEAD (DARK LIGHTS REMIX)
LORD I JUST CAN'T KEEP FROM CRYING SOMETIMES

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d25.blurb: Toro Y Moi's latest LP is a noticeable improvement compared to the sketchbook of ideas that made up his last album, Causers of this. Underneath the Pine is loaded with light, pretty arrangements and dancey disco beats. The songwriting and vocals aren't always standout, though.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d2c.blurb: Yuck's latest album is a fun embrace of the sound on classic albums from Dinosaur Jr., Yo La Tengo, Elliott Smith, and many more artists and bands considered "90s."

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d2d.blurb: Siriusmo's debut LP is a bipolar exploration through the German electronica producer's psyche. Not to say that he's crazy, but his music is a little all over the place.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d3b.blurb: Weedeater's new LP is a heavy piece of work. This album's got a lot of rumble to it, but I'd say the sound here grinds your ear drums more than it shake's 'em.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d3c.blurb: Tim Hecker's latest album is a barren wasteland of forgotten sounds. It's music you can truly wander through.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d43.blurb: As much as it pains me to say this, there's not much about this new Raekwon album that excites me. The beats attempt to copy the trademark RZA sound, the rhymes are decent at best, and the features are simply alright, too.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d4f.blurb: On their latest LP, the Strokes want to head in a new direction, but they can't decide on one. So they use every track to obtain a different sound.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d54.blurb: It seemed impossible, but the Pains of Being Pure at Heart have somehow found a way to sound sweeter and more innocent than they did on their self-titled debut. This slight change in direction didn't sit well with me on first listen, though.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d56.blurb: Craft Spells' debut LP is a mutated mixtape of the best sounds new wave had to offer. It's a kind of shy LP, but the tunes will definitely stick with anyone willing to lean in and give a close listen.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d5c.blurb: Though it is fun to see Bibio cover so much ground on this album--jumping from cowbell rock ballads to odd electronics without batting an eye--the songs behind the sounds aren't doing all that much for me.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d63.blurb: Trap Them's third album won't be a shock if you've heard their earlier work, but they have inched once more toward a unified sound.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d65.blurb: I enjoy Animal Collective as much as the next guy, which is why I'm baffled by this album failing to translate in any sort of major enjoyment to me.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d68.blurb: Holy Ghost!'s debut LP is buff with great sounds, songs, and production value. This is not some soggy, lo-fi set of dance tracks you'd find for free on the internet somewhere. This is a crisp, lush barrage of beats and hooks.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d6d.blurb: The Vaccines don't have the most original of styles or tunes, but they know a catchy hook when they hear one. What Did You Expect From the Vaccines? is a record that functions on those basic principles of a catchy rock album: energy, straightforwardness, volume.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d6f.blurb: Timber Timbre's latest album is a scarily obsessive look at one man's post-relationship trauma. The infatuation in the lyrics here runs deep, and it's tempting to hear the record from beginning to end just to see how bad the train wreck gets.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d79.blurb: On their latest LP bring a lotta tunes with little cohesion. There's a kinda shaky love song theme linking some of these tracks together, but it doesn't stop tracks like "No Future Shock" from jumping in out of nowhere.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d86.blurb: On their latest album, Crystal Stilts brings what made their full-length debut great while still adding some extra sounds to the mix.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d95.blurb: On their third LP, Metronomy lowers their eccentric characteristics to a simmer and gives their songwriting strenghts a workout. The track list hits with one great tune after another.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090d9f.blurb: Wasting Light is easily one of Foo Fighters' most consistent effort in their past several albums, but it's not resonating with me like I wanted it to. Chalk it up to the album just not being my style, I suppose.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090da1.blurb: Rotten Sound's Curse is a loud record. No one can deny that. They have the speedy blast beats, vocals, and guitar riffs every grindcore band should have. However, this LP loses a lot of potential energy in its extremely regulated recording.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090da2.blurb: Wormrot's brand of grindcore will probably strike most people as being old school. Their dedication to thrash metal riffs and a natural-sounding production style calls back to the genre's salad days in the 80s.

fav.t: YOU SUFFER BUT WHY IS THAT MY PROBLEM

6684c32c49ea2a054e090db4.blurb: Every time a Kills album comes on, I feel a bunch of involuntary reflexes coming on: my eyes squint, my lips tighten, and my shoulders start to shrug. I'm just unsure of why this music should appeal to me.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090dbb.blurb: The overarching theme on Apocalypse seems clear, but the chapters in this story are kind of vague, making it difficult for me to really get into this album.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090dc3.blurb: On their latest album CunninLyngusits bring some seriously cinematic production. All of the atmospheric textures make the perfect setting for lyrical themes dealing with dreams.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090dc5.blurb: On their latest album, the Beastie Boys still sound like they're at the top of their game--which is fantastic considering their age. There's a kinetic energy between the three of them that's difficult to explain.

fav.t: HERE'S A LITTLE SOMETHIN' FOR YA

6684c32c49ea2a054e090dd0.blurb: On their latest album, Explosions In the Sky gives the appearance of evolution with some added instrumentation: acoustic guitar, strings, hums, looped percussion, and other miscellaneous noises.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090ddd.blurb: On Helplessness Blues, Fleet Foxes improve just about everything that they were doing on their last album. Keep in mind the key word here is "improve," not change.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090dea.blurb: On their latest album, the Antlers work to improve the lo-fi recording quality they were dealing with on their last album, and they definitely succeed in that department. The instruments and the mix sound absolutely fantastic.

fav.t: EVERY NIGHT MY TEETH ARE FALLING OUT

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e02.blurb: Wild Beast's Smother shows the band toning things down, and making a sound that comes off eerier than the material on their previous two albums. Though this LP still holds some of the grooves their last albums did, the songs here carry a much more serious tone--maybe too serious?

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e09.blurb: Turtleneck and Chain has some pretty memorable tacks on it, to be honest. Some of these might be the best this comedy rap outfit has ever penned.

fav.t: I THEW IT ON THE GROUND

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e0c.blurb: On Liturgy's latest album, the interplay and musicianship that made 2009's Renihilation so memorable are magnified with tons of syncopation and detail.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e0f.blurb: On the band's latest album, Manchester Orchestra seems to lose of a lot of the passion and rock 'n' roll momentum that have made their last two LPs pretty decent. They've exchanged this for some relatively heavier production and string arrangements.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e19.blurb: On hit latest release, Amon Tobin isn't building songs as much as he is sounds. The textures on most of this album are absolutely amazing, and among the best this Brazilian electronica producer has ever created.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e22.blurb: On their sophomore album, Australia's the UV Race brings garage rock to a dirtier and grimier level than most. The band's loose song structures and loose playing bring a lot of, well, "character" to these recordings.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e29.blurb: This Will Destroy You's latest LP starts and finished with flying colors, but it gets a little underwhelming in the middle for me.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e31.blurb: If my son had made this album, I'd say this:

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e4e.blurb: On Coma Cinema's third album lo-fi production backs up some real-life sadness on about 15 songs. It's a little spotty, but nothing really sticks around long enough to disappoint. Some songs here really did hit me as memorable on my first listen, though.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e51.blurb: My Morning Jacket's latest album was a two-part surprise for me. First, I was happy to hear how alive and ambitious the first half of this album was.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e60.blurb: Theophilus London's new EP, Lover's Holiday, is a piece of pop rap I can really get down with. Not only are some strong new wave influences tastefully shown on off this thing, but the songwriting is crafted for maximum enjoyability.

fav.t: FLYING OVERSEAS (FEAT. DEVONTE HYNES & SOLANGE KNOWLES)

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e61.blurb: OK, so it's widely acknowledged that a lot of people don't care about Death Cab for cutie anymore. I guess I used to be one of them, too.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e62.blurb: Come, my children! Indulge in this glorious thrash metal!

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e69.blurb: What can I say about Planningtorock's latest album that's positive? Honestly, not much. Not only that, but I'm awestruck at how positive some of the receptions have been to what she's doing.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e6a.blurb: On its latest release, Woods make their sound a little sunnier with brighter guitar leads and attitudes. But some of the songs here just feel too unfinished to really feel memorable or exciting for me.

fav.t: WHO DO I THINK I AM?

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e72.blurb: On Arctic Monkeys' latest album, the band drains themselves of adrenaline to play a set of songs that go back in time and try to revive a group of dated sounds. The guys play with sunshine pop, garage rock, and even some Queens of the Stone Age-esque riffage make it into the mix.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e7c.blurb: Considering this album's lineup change, its group of new guest singers, Gloss Drop must have been a bit of a challenge for Battles. Also, don't forget to add the fact this thing is the band's Sophomore LP, which comes after a highly praised first album.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e8a.blurb: On Fucked Up's new album, the band brings concept to the forefront for a group of songs that tell a dramatic tale of love and loss. It's pretty, well, complicated.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e8e.blurb: What album should I review next, eh? And what do you think of this album from Poor Lilly? Love it? Hate it? Why?

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e92.blurb: WU LYF's debut album rides in on a tidal wave of reverb and eccentric yelps from the band's lead singer. While it does have a uniform sound and a style, I feel like the style drowns out what this band has to offer in this songs most of the time.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e93.blurb: On Blood Ceremony's second album, the Canadian band embraces a traditional style of doom metal; but they still manage to make worlds collide.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090e9c.blurb: On Bon Iver's Bon Iver, the project opens the floodgates and welcomes in a sea of new instrumentation. Everything from clarinet to string arrangements are laced into these songs to widen the spectrum of sounds that were once so sparse four years ago on For Emma, Forever Ago.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090eab.blurb: On Iceage's full-length debut, the band forges a cohesive style in raw, messy musicianship and noisy guitars. Sometimes it's overwhelming, and sometimes it's just catchy and loveable. But it's always giving off some kind of strong energy or emotion--even at its most apathetic.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090ebb.blurb: On Black Up, Shabazz Palaces take hip hop deep into the left field with odd beats and surreal effects. It's definitely an indulgent LP that requires a little bit of effort from the listener, but repeating these songs until they completely unfold is worth the wait.

SWERVE... THE REEPING OF ALL THAT WORTHWHILE

6684c32c49ea2a054e090ed5.blurb: Ulcerate's latest album might not hit the spot for fans of the New Zealand group's more hectic material, but it definitely resonated with me. The relentless drumming and dissonant guitar passages create an ugly atmosphere that's ever-evolving.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090ede.blurb: Limp Bizkit's new album is VEGAN SHAKE, HUMMUS, CHIPS, CARROTS, PEANUT BUTTER, RAISINS, SALAD, ITALIAN DRESSING, POMEGRANATE JUICE, CHOCOLATE ALMOND MILK.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090eea.blurb: Compton rapper Kendrick Lamar doesn't follow the usual tough and hardened stereotypes that come with repping the California city. The guy isn't a wimp, but he's more interested in saying something thought-provoking than violent.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090eef.blurb: Washed Out's debut LP definitely brings a comparative change from the project's early EPs. I guess my issue is that the change just isn't enough to make me wanna stick with this album over previous efforts.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090efb.blurb: On the Horrors third LP, the primary colors that combined to created the band's eccentric brand of post-punk start to fade a little bit; however, I think the move is sort of intentional.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f05.blurb: On its latest album, Zombi throws guitars and bass to the wayside, and brings the focus back to the duo's foundation: drums and synths. It might just be the direction longtime fans wanted after the extremely rock-oriented Spirit Animal.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f11.blurb: On Toxic Holocaust's fourth album, the Portland band takes a leaner approach to its grimy fusion of punk and thrash metal, lowering the black metal influences that were once prominent on the band's earlier releases.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f18.blurb: Alaska's Portugal. The Man made its Atlantic Records debut with this new album, In the Mountain In the Cloud. And because I didn't really like the band's past two albums, I'm surprised to see the music moving in a direction I like a lot more this time around.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f21.blurb: If the rock history books stay accurate, Brooklyn's They Might Be Giants will go down as being one of the most idiosyncratic bands of all-time--even if that idiosyncrasy seems to wane a little bit on Join Us.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f32.blurb: Little Dragon's third album comes after a move toward accessibility on 2009's machine dreams, but doesn't go further down that path. Making things simpler to gain a wider audience just seems like something a band in Little Dragons' shoes would do, though.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f39.blurb: Though Blackenedwhite isn't perfect, it's definitely a likeable release from this OFWGKTA-affiliated duo.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f3e.blurb: Unknown Mortal Orchestra's debut full-length surprised me in some places, but underwhelmed in others. I love how effortlessly these guys pull together a fun and bouncy salute to the world of 60s rock and pop. It sounds as fresh as it does retro.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f48.blurb: Despite a bit of genre-hopping, Machinedrum's latest album, Room(s), comes together quite nicely.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f53.blurb: While Hudson Mohawke's new EP isn't flashy, detailed, or technically impressive, I still have a lot of fun listening to it. For lack of a better word, I think what actually attracts me to the instrumentals on this thing is that they sound, well, dorky!

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f58.blurb: This compilation features 15 cuts from a time span of several years in Nigeria's musical history.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f5b.blurb: For me, Beirut's new album is a small step back from the Flying Club Cup and the March of the Zapotec EP that preceded it. I was sure all this waiting would result in something bigger and better, but the ambition needed for that doesn't surface on the Rip Tide.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f6a.blurb: Gonna man up! Review some jazz!

fav.t: LIBATION FOR MR. BROWN: BID 'EM IN...

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f75.blurb: New York's Cerebral Ballzy have a lot of energy and rage, but I still don't know what exactly is causing all of it. It's just my opinion, but I didn't find much to get enraged over in the lyrics on this album. Being told where to pee should be the least of society's worries.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f76.blurb: On Rival Sons' sophomore album, the California quartet makes the classic sounds of hard rock and blues rock kind of exciting again. While these dudes are nowhere near as flashy as some of the bands that influence them, they do pull together some really great sounds on this LP.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f89.blurb: The War On Drugs' Slave Ambient is a glistening set of folk rock tunes and kinda ambient instrumentals. The production, for me, is a real blessing on this LP. The sounds are so pretty, which actually makes me wanna revisit a great deal of these tracks.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f97.blurb: Active Child's sophomore release has some pretty haunting and beautiful sounds. Lone member Pat Grossi's choir boy falsetto is undeniably good. Plus, all the effects he laces into these tracks makes this LP an interesting listen.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090f9c.blurb: Detroit rapper Danny Brown's latest album functions in extremes. They're not really the angry, voluminous extremes the latest Death Grips album functions on. They're more like extremes of excess.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fa6.blurb: Connecticut rapper Apathy brings a modern feel to the classic sounds of East Coast hip hop on his latest album, Honkey Kong. Though this LP doesn't experiment or step over any major boundaries, it does come with a lot of consistency, quotable lyricism, and solid beats.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fab.blurb: Dan Barrett's latest project, a full-length album and book, is both a personal and fictional exploration of death, suicide, depression, and the afterlife. Because of that, this video takes a look at both the music and the book that comes with this package.

fav.t: NO ONE IS EVER GOING TO WANT ME

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fad.blurb: It's a Lil Wayne album. What did you expect?

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fb4.blurb: One of the longest-running acts in alternative rock has a new album out, Considering I grew up with a lotta this band's stuff on the radio, I thought I'd be a little more excited to hear the Chili Peppers have a new album out, Sadly, I wasn't, but I'm glad you guys pointed my ear…

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fb9.blurb: Stylistically, I think Tripper is an exciting return to Hella's old, stripped down form. Some fans may see it as a bit of a regression, but that's only half of the truth.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fc4.blurb: The Drums' sophomore release, Portamento, was an album I was pretty excited for. The group's self-titled debut contained some of my favorite singles of last year, and I was hoping the same would happen with this release.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fca.blurb: At least I like it more than that EP.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fcf.blurb: The Men's latest album, Leave Home, has some pretty abrasive, heavy, and eye-widening production on it.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fd0.blurb: On some level, I consider myself a fan of Wolves In the Throne Room: the Olympia, Washington black metal outfit. If I wasn't, I don't think I would have followed their exploits up until this point.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fd8.blurb: On St. VIncent's latest album, singer-songwriter Annie Clark comes together with some pretty bold and experimental flavors.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fd9.blurb: Sad to say, I'm not big on this new Neon Indian album. I'd like to think that it's not because of the hype that was built around the project's last album, Psychic Chasms, but I'm afraid that might be a possibility.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fe1.blurb: Das Racist's Relax is a bit of a letdown for me. I just didn't enjoy it as much as the tapes. There are plenty of tracks here where the guys are their usual, hilarious selves.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090fe8.blurb: If you love cute rock tunes with a dismal outlook on life, Veronica Falls might be the band for you. Their latest LP is simple, immediate, and catchy.

6684c32c49ea2a054e090ff3.blurb: Ah, the new Opeth record. Was I expecting to like this? No. Was I hoping I'd like this? Yes! A big, fat "yes," actually.

6684c32c49ea2a054e091004.blurb: On the Hunter, Mastodon's sludgy take on progressive metal is sounding more accessible than ever.

6684c32c49ea2a054e091006.blurb: On his first official full-length album on Roc Nation, rapper and producer J. Cole takes the talents he's been perfecting on past mixtapes and goes big time with them.

6684c32c49ea2a054e091007.blurb: On his latest solo effort, legendary producer 9th Wonder invites some of his favorite MCs to spit over his beats and celebrate his relevancy as a fixture in hip hop.

6684c32c49ea2a054e091016.blurb: Wilco's latest album is a huge rise in energy compared to the band's last two releases, pumping out numerous catchy, straightforward rock tunes and ballads.

6684c32c49ea2a054e09101b.blurb: La Dispute's Wildlife is a fantastic and rewarding gauntlet of emotional rock music. Even if post-hardcore isn't in your comfort zone, this album is worth a shot.

fav.t: SAFER IN THE FOREST / LOVE SONG FOR POOR MICHIGAN

6684c32c49ea2a054e091057.blurb: On the sophomore Justice album, this French house duo starts emulating its influences--70s rock, pop, disco--with a mix of different results.

6684c32c49ea2a054e09105c.blurb: On a new, collaborative EP, Detroit hip hop artists Black Milk and Danny Brown team up and prove their city isn't the only thing they have in common.

6684c32c49ea2a054e091062.blurb: On its debut EP, this UK outfit finds a way to translate flashy musicianship into a filthy, disturbing reinterpretation of technical death metal. Oh, there's a bit of grindcore in here, too.

6684c32c49ea2a054e091067.blurb: Together, Lou Reed and Metallica come up with an album that, well, isn't as terrible as everyone assumed it would be. In my opinion, anyway.

6684c32c49ea2a054e091078.blurb: On My Brightest Diamond's newest album, singer-songwriter Shara Worden releases another set of heavily orchestrated art pop tunes. This time, many of the lyrical themes revolve heavily around relationships.

6684c32c49ea2a054e09109c.blurb: On Drake's latest album, the Canadian rapper and singer embraces what makes him unique, and sounds great doing it. There is a noticeable hunk of filler on this LP, though.

6684c32c49ea2a054e0910a4.blurb: Aside from a few new sounds, Crystal Stilts really hasn't progressed its sound past In Love With Oblivion. But for fans, that may not necessarily be a bad thing.

6684c32c49ea2a054e0910b0.blurb: While Wale's latest album doesn't feature anything terrible on its hour of material, I couldn't help but feel a little underwhelmed.

6684c32c49ea2a054e0910b1.blurb: After a series of mixtapes I casually enjoyed, Mac Miller's sound gets sweeter on his full-length debut, Blue Slide Park.

6684c32c49ea2a054e0910cb.blurb: The Spits' latest self-titled release continues to slowly develop the band's distorted, grimy take on the art of punk rock.

6684c32c49ea2a054e0910cc.blurb: On Yelawolf's latest album, the Alabama rapper makes his Shady Records debut with a commercial release whose results are a bit mixed.

6684c32c49ea2a054e0910d2.blurb: The new Red Horse album is a little front-loaded, but it still showcases some pretty intriguing noise and free improvisational sounds.

6684c32c49ea2a054e0910d9.blurb: On Oneohtrix Point Never's latest album, producer Daniel Lopatin casually saunters into the field of sample-based music, and kicks total ass.

WHERE I END AND THE HEMLOCK BEGINS
LOST IN THE STATIC BETWEEN WORLDS
